answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, since every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The reef cap is policed at intake and pearl exposes the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a kernel tag. That is 26 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
